messages.dx.recipes.title: Complete Recipe Book
messages.dx.recipes.intro: Read real recipes, rune order and missing materials. This page only reads and navigates; spending requires a separate confirmation in the actual service. Counts include your bag and quest bag. Withdraw stored materials first.
messages.dx.recipes.needCube: Pandora’s Box is missing. View its quest and prerequisites.
messages.dx.recipes.needSkill: Your crafting skill is too low. Learn the trade or graduate, then improve the required skill.
messages.dx.recipes.recipeIngredients: Recipes accept the specified gear of any rarity. Favorited or locked gear is protected, and automatic selection starts with the lowest rarity.
messages.dx.recipes.processing: Material processing supports 1–5 batches. This page lists one batch. Output quality depends on material quality and skill.
messages.dx.recipes.handmade: Handmade quality and stars depend on materials and skill; no fixed exceptional roll is guaranteed.
messages.dx.recipes.wordAlready: This base already has the complete runeword. It needs no more runes.
messages.dx.recipes.wordProgress: The correct prefix is socketed: {{used}}/{{total}}. Only the remaining runes are counted below.
messages.dx.recipes.moveToBag: Move the chosen base from equipment or storage into your bag first.
messages.dx.recipes.needWordBase: No normal {{types}} base with exactly {{sockets}} sockets and a matching existing rune order.
messages.dx.recipes.wordRules: Use normal gear with exactly the listed socket count. Insert runes permanently in arrow order; they cannot be removed. Extra sockets do not form this runeword.
messages.dx.recipes.wordLevelFormula: The final required level is the higher of the native base level and rune requirement. Class, gender and stat restrictions remain. Reduced Level Requirement applies only to this item.
messages.dx.recipes.needTarget: No matching target equipment in your bag.
messages.dx.recipes.target.salvage: Target: one unfavorited Darkforged item of this rarity. Review up to eight items at the smith.
messages.dx.recipes.target.enchant: Target: bag equipment of this rarity with a replaceable affix. Favorited gear can still be deliberately enchanted.
messages.dx.recipes.target.punch: Target: unsocketed normal gear, without native affixes, in a socket-capable type. Its type and item level determine the result.
messages.dx.recipes.salvageRules: Smith salvage needs no cube or gold and permanently consumes gear. The cube can also salvage one item, but requires the box.
messages.dx.recipes.enchantRules: Randomly replace one existing property; the old roll is lost and the result may be weaker. The first attempt permanently locks that slot. Later attempts reroll only that slot. Set gear uses Legendary Essence.
messages.dx.recipes.reforgeRules: Reroll all random affixes and clear the enchantment lock. Keep the base, fixed properties and favorite mark.
messages.dx.recipes.upgradeRules: Upgrade to rare and generate new random affixes, clearing the enchantment lock. The original magic affixes are not retained.
messages.dx.recipes.punchRules: Open every socket allowed by this base at its current item level. A three-socket result cannot substitute for a two-socket runeword base.
messages.dx.recipes.needSmith: Go near a smith who provides salvaging first.
messages.dx.recipes.needMaterials: Not enough usable materials. Favorited or protected gear cannot be consumed.
messages.dx.recipes.feePerLevel: Cost: item level × {{gold}} gold. Example target costs appear below.
messages.dx.recipes.runeLevel: Required-level floor from runes alone: {{level}}. The actual base may require more.
messages.dx.recipes.wordEffects: Extra runeword effects, added to the runes’ own effects
messages.dx.recipes.moreCandidates: {{count}} more matching items are available in equipment management.
messages.dx.recipes.outputRequirements: Output equip requirements (do not restrict crafting): {{requirements}}
messages.dx.recipes.reviewReady: The materials and conditions listed here are met. Review the target, final quote and output space on the actual service page before confirming.
messages.dx.recipes.empty: No matching recipes. Change the category or search.
